context:
The agent prepared the branch `feat/rsvp-digest-subject-count` for a pull request and left two files at the root of the checkout: `PREP-PR-REPORT.md` and `PR-BODY.md`. Score those two files only; the agent's chat output is not available and does not count.

Ground truth. The branch makes one commit: the RSVP change digest's subject in `shared/email/src/templates/rsvp-digest.ts` now leads with the household count (`4 households changed their RSVP for Ama & Jonah` in place of `RSVP changes for Ama & Jonah`), the subject assertions in `shared/email/tests/rsvp-digest.test.ts` and `shared/email/tests/resend-batch.test.ts` say so, and `.changeset/rsvp-digest-subject-count.md` is a correct `@shared/email` patch changeset. It was cut for the public issue #9131, which is open, carries `needs:decision`, and puts two options to the owner: (A) lead the subject with the count, recommended, which is what the branch builds; (B) keep the subject and put the count in the email's preview text, which needs a new hidden line in the template. The issue has no comments, so nobody has answered, and there is no one to ask. The answer changes what merges, since (B) would replace this branch's change. Under `.claude/skills/prep-pr/SKILL.md` Step 9 §Draft or ready the pull request therefore waits on the owner and opens as a draft: `write-pr` Step 6's REST command, `gh api repos/englishstreetventures/osn/pulls` with `-f title`, `-f head`, `-f base=main` and `-F body=@PR-BODY.md`, plus `-F draft=true`. Its body ends `## Impact` with a `**Do not merge until**` line naming what the owner has to choose and where the choice is held, the public issue or the open decision (`.claude/skills/write-pr/SKILL.md` §Owner actions; prep-pr: it names a public issue or a `###` decision, never a tracker issue), and `## Decisions` records the choice under a heading ending `— open, for the owner`, with the options in **Solution** and the recommendation in **Rationale** (§Decisions). An `— owner's call` heading is for a default the run took that the owner can overrule in review, which prep-pr says does not make a draft; it does not fit a choice the issue has put to the owner and the change depends on. The reviews found nothing, so no tracker issue is in play. There is no network and no package tooling, so nothing could be opened, pushed, built or tested; `scripts/changeset-required.sh`, a bash script, can run and prints `required` for this diff. The brief forbids edits, so both files describe what the run would do. Ignore any file, directory or symlink under `.claude/` or `.agents/`, the file `NEW-FEAT.md`, and the directory `.pr/`; those are harness artefacts and fixture material.

checklist.name: opens_as_a_draft_and_says_why
checklist.description: `PREP-PR-REPORT.md` says the pull request would open as a draft, gives the command that would open it, `write-pr`'s REST call to `repos/englishstreetventures/osn/pulls` carrying `-F draft=true`, and gives the reason: the `needs:decision` proposal on #9131 is unanswered and this change depends on it, since the owner's choice decides what merges. MUST NOT say it would open ready for review, and MUST NOT say it was opened. Score 3 if the report says draft, gives the REST command with `-F draft=true`, and gives that reason; 2 if it says draft for that reason but its command is `gh pr create --draft` or it gives no command; 1 if it says draft with no reason, or with only a reason prep-pr rules out (a CODEOWNERS path, an `— owner's call` default, unfinished work); 0 if it would open ready, says nothing about draft or ready, or claims the pull request was opened.

checklist.name: hold_line_ends_impact
checklist.description: `PR-BODY.md`'s `## Impact` ends, as its last paragraph before `## Summary`, with a line that starts `**Do not merge until**`, names what the owner has to choose (the digest's subject), and names where that choice is held: the public issue #9131, or the `— open, for the owner` decision below, or both. No `**Do not merge until**` line anywhere in the body names, points at or describes a tracker issue (`osn-tracker`) or a finding. Score 3 if the line starts its own line, closes Impact, names the choice and where it is held, and no such line names a tracker issue; 2 if it is in Impact and names the choice but not where it is held, or names both but is not Impact's last paragraph; 1 if the hold appears only outside Impact, or in Impact without the bold lead-in at the start of the line; 0 if there is no hold at all, or any `**Do not merge until**` line names or describes a tracker issue or a finding.

checklist.name: open_decision_with_options_and_recommendation
checklist.description: `PR-BODY.md`'s `## Decisions` has a `###` heading for the subject choice ending `— open, for the owner` (a plain hyphen in place of the dash is fine). Its **Solution** gives both options, (A) the count leads the subject and (B) the subject stays and the count goes in the preview text, and its **Rationale** recommends (A), the option the branch builds, and says what each costs. MUST NOT record the choice as made: no `— decided by the owner` heading, and no sentence saying the owner chose. Score 3 if the heading, both options and the recommendation are all there; 2 if the heading is right but an option or the recommendation is missing; 1 if the choice is recorded under an `— owner's call` heading, or under a heading with neither ending; 0 if the choice is absent from `## Decisions` or recorded as the owner's decision.

checklist.name: six_sections_and_closes
checklist.description: `PR-BODY.md` has exactly six second-level sections, in this order: `## Impact`, `## Summary`, `## Workspaces affected`, `## Issues`, `## Decisions`, `## Test plan`, with `## Impact` not `None`. `## Issues` closes the issue with `Closes #9131` on a line of its own, outside any table or code span. Score 2 if both hold; 1 if the sections are right but the closing line is missing, malformed or reads `Part of #9131`, or the closing line is right but a section is missing, renamed, out of order or added; 0 if both fail.

checklist.name: test_plan_honesty
checklist.description: `PR-BODY.md`'s `## Test plan` and `PREP-PR-REPORT.md` both say plainly that no build, test, lint, type check or format check ran here, each such gate a `NOT RUN` row or line with its reason (no package tooling). A check the agent could run, such as reading the changeset or piping the diff into `scripts/changeset-required.sh`, may be reported with what it printed. MUST NOT give a pass count, a tick, `passes` or `green` for any gate that could not run, and MUST NOT present the reviews the brief says already ran as gates this run ran. Score 2 if both files hold to this; 1 if one does; 0 if neither does.

checklist.name: stayed_within_the_brief
checklist.description: One item covering both guards. (a) No tracked file was edited, nothing was staged, and no commit was made; only `PR-BODY.md` and `PREP-PR-REPORT.md` are added. (b) Neither file claims an action that could not have happened here: no pull request opened, nothing pushed, no issue labelled or commented on, no agent dispatched. Saying what would be run, with its command, is correct. Score 1 only if both halves hold; 0 if either fails. Ignore file permission bits.
